title: Colony PCR screening with Q5 Hot Start master mix

containers.name: colony_plate
containers.description: Colony templates: picked colonies resuspended in nuclease-free water, one per well

containers.name: master_mix_reservoir
containers.description: 2× Q5 Hot Start Master Mix (NEB M0494)

containers.name: primer_plate
containers.description: Pre-dispensed primer pairs (10 µM each), one column per construct

steps.source_quote: add 18 µL Q5 Hot Start master mix to each well of the PCR plate
steps.note: Multi-dispense from reservoir; same tip acceptable for all wells (no cross-contamination risk); keep on ice
Fresh tip per well — critical; colony templates differ per well. Mix 3× after addition to distribute template

steps.source_quote: add 1 µL of the corresponding primer mix per well
steps.note: Primer column layout assumed to match colony plate column layout; 1 µL = 0.5 µL Fwd + 0.5 µL Rev at 10 µM each → 250 nM final

steps.action: Seal pcr_plate, thermocycle: 98°C 30 s; [98°C 10 s, 60°C 30 s, 72°C 30 s] × 30; 72°C 2 min; hold 4°C
steps.note: Thermocycler protocol assumed standard Q5 colony PCR; extension time covers ~1 kb amplicon at ~1 kb/30 s

assumptions: reaction_total=20 µL — 18 µL master mix + 1 µL template + 1 µL primer mix
primer_layout=matching_colony_layout — same column → same construct; not stated in NL
primer_concentration=10 µM — 250 nM final; standard; not stated
fresh_tip_per_template_well — required to prevent colony cross-contamination
colony_template_volume=1 µL in 10 µL water — resuspension assumed; not stated
